name: Sengoku no Michi
source:
This visual novel features three heroines from Sengoku Rance: Kenshin, Ran, and Isoroku.

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE034359.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
本作是一部以《戰國蘭斯》中的三位女主角——謙信、蘭和五十六為主角的視覺小說。

[編譯自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE034359.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
